profile.description: Warm Northglenn relationship. 2026 Pirate Fest will not use Adventure Zone because of budget cuts and limited space, but Michael Ringling said they definitely want Adventure Zone involved in the future. A possible stronger 2027 opportunity is around July 4th as more of a standalone Adventure Zone event. Reconnect in Jan-Feb 2027.

notes.subject: Aug. 28, 2026 call outcome — future opportunity
notes.body: Spoke with Michael Ringling. Northglenn definitely wants Adventure Zone involved in the future, but Pirate Fest 2026 is not workable because of budget cuts and limited space. Michael indicated July 4th may be a better opportunity in 2027, potentially as more of a standalone Adventure Zone event. Remove the 2026 Pirate Fest calendar placeholder and reconnect in Jan-Feb 2027.

followUps.label: Follow up with Michael Ringling about 2027 Northglenn opportunities
followUps.reason: 2026 Pirate Fest passed because of budget cuts and limited space, but Michael said they definitely want Adventure Zone in the future. Ask about a 2027 July 4th opportunity and whether a larger standalone Adventure Zone setup could work.
